About

I'm Bright Gyamfi, founder of Klaus Graphix. I'm a Ghanaian visual and motion designer specializing in brand identity and 3D text and typography designer. For the past 4 years, I've helped startups, events, and small businesses turn ideas into bold visuals — from logo marks built on a geometric grid in Illustrator, to animated title sequences in After Effects.My toolkit: Illustrator, Photoshop, Cinema 4D, After Effects. My focus: identity systems, illustration, and animation that has a purpose. Not just motion for motion's sake — motion that tells a story.If you have a project that needs a strong static image and a reason to move, let's talk.
